subject: Migrate sha1 unit test to new framework (#470)
reason: This change only migrates the sha1 unit test from the legacy SERVER_TEST framework to the new unit test framework: it deletes test-only code (sha1Test, compiled only under #ifdef SERVER_TEST) and adds src/unit/test_sha1.c with the same test logic plus an expected-digest assertion. The production SHA1 implementation (SHA1Init/SHA1Update/SHA1Final) and all server runtime behavior are unchanged, so no command reply, replication, persistence, or crash path differs between the builds and no scenario can reach any behavioral difference.
